_delta: vs canon4v: the film rung's output only (120 vs 40). vs the measured canon-4rung (F98–F103): the whole structure — vanilla names and eras (dynamite, repeaters, breech-loading artillery back at era 3; combustion engine and telephone at 4; crystal glass at 2; only vulcanization moved, 3 → 4), 57 buildings (canon-4rung 63: no minted textile/glass/tooling/steel/arms/artillery/automotive/academy top rungs, no dough-rollers, art-silk, electrical-generation or radio rungs), the six hoard ai_defines NOT carried, the streetlight override and trade-centre ai_value NOT carried, the 1836 start vanilla's (no chain seed), the 14 technology renames gone.

_predictions.P1_canon4v_gdp: This batch is canon4v's first measurement as much as the academy's. World GDP at 1935 lands 0.75–1.00× the vanilla n=16 median and the shortlist 0.9–1.3× — inside canon-4rung's spread (0.65–0.96× / 0.81–1.30×). The hoard defines' absence moves construction, not GDP, by more than the seed spread: private queue depth at 1900 differs from canon-4rung's by less than the seed-to-seed range.
_predictions.P2_later_gates: With dynamite, repeaters and breech-loading artillery back at vanilla's era 3 and combustion engine at 4, the tiered era mix at 1880 sits BEHIND canon-4rung's: the e2 share of tiered workers at 1880 lower than canon-4rung's median, the 1935 mix inside its spread.
_predictions.P3_art_price: F103 stands: profit-driven entry pins fine art near 130–175% of base regardless of the ladder. A ×3 film rung does NOT cheapen fine art in any market for more than a decade; British fine art at 1935 ≥ 100% of base in ≥ 4 of 5 seeds. The AI builds FEWER academy levels (a level makes 3× the art), so academy employment at 1935 is below canon4-je's / canon4-art's.
_predictions.P4_art_mix: Where film is held, the e3 rung dominates: in the leaders with `film` by 1925, e3's share of academy levels at 1935 > 50% in ≥ 3 of 5 seeds; rungs 0–1 empty out (their break-even is 4–8× e3's per unit).
_predictions.P5_no_spillover: No leisure-budget or SoL effect (F103): the shortlist's average SoL at 1935 and the other leisure goods' prices inside canon4v's own seed spread.
_predictions.P6_je: Britain's research-entry completions 25–45 unique (country, technology, stage) triplets per run (canon4-je 29–43), techs held at 1935 within ±10 of canon4-je's; the coal+iron motor anchor fires only for tier 3–5 countries (tiers 1–2 hold atmospheric_engine from 1836).
_predictions.P7_stall: ≤ 1 of 5 seeds stalls (the ab2/ab3 family stalled 1 in 5); a stall is named and excluded from the summary, and n is stated.

_cost: 5 × 1836→1936 ≈ 5 × 2h35 ≈ 13 h on the mod's measured pace (F79 curves).
_caveats: Two changes against the measured book at once — the structure (canon4v) and the academy's ×3 film rung. The academy is 0.3–0.4% of construction and F103 showed a ×16 ladder moved nothing outside the academy, so the batch reads as canon4v's measurement with the academy reading on top; if anything outside the academy differs from canon-4rung, the structure is the first suspect, not the film rung.
canon-4rung was measured WITH the six hoard ai_defines; canon4v carries only the cost-divisor define. A construction-pace difference is therefore expected and is not a finding about the ladder.
Vanilla names: building loc reads 'Era N. Arts Academy (Film Art). BE target X%' — the first batch on the derived naming scheme; anything ugly in the ledger's labels is cosmetic.
